people.name: Admah
people.line: One of the cities destroyed with Sodom and Gomorrah.

people.name: Bera
people.line: King of Sodom during Abraham's time

people.name: Birsha
people.line: King of Gomorrah during Abraham's time

people.name: Gomorrah
people.line: Wicked city destroyed by God along with Sodom.

people.name: Shinab
people.line: King of Admah who rebelled against Chedorlaomer.

people.name: Sodom
people.line: Wicked city destroyed by God for its sins

people.name: Zeboiim
people.line: One of the cities of the plain destroyed with Sodom

people.name: Zoar
people.line: A city near Sodom, spared from destruction

translations.web: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).
translations.bsb: went to war against Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).
translations.kjv: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
translations.asv: that they made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar).
